items.title: St. Lawrence and northern boundary repair: completed annual evidence

queries.reportingPeriod: 2025 model year; fresh annual replay and independent checks October 15, 2026

source.label: Frozen source-defined candidate and completed 12-month AC replay

metricDefinitions.label: MAE
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean absolute modeled minus observed interface flow over the identical paired cohort, in public-scale MW.

metricDefinitions.label: WAPE
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 times sum of absolute errors divided by sum of absolute observed flows; primary terminal convention unchanged.

metricDefinitions.label: Generation energy
metricDefinitions.definition: All physical hours, including separately flagged latent excluded hours, sum to each final EIA monthly St. Lawrence target.

filters: 8651 source-qualified hours compared with the completed physical_repair_v1 baseline.
8760 UTC positions retained; all original 109 exclusions remain excluded.
caveats: Monthly energy agreement does not certify actual hourly generation; the 855 MW capability bound and monthly inventory availability are declared engineering assumptions.
The source-verified North Country structure includes PV20. Sand Bar metering is a proxy for the Plattsburgh boundary, with South Hero load, losses and historical sign applicability qualified.
Physical P32 meter equivalence remains uncertified. Combined changes do not identify separate causal error contributions.
All 8651 attempted hours pass equation, loss and recovery checks, but zero hours pass every network operating limit.
Total East MAE increases and Moses South positive bias increases; the repair is not an improvement across every metric.

evidenceFlow.title: Source constraints
evidenceFlow.detail: St. Lawrence full-year energy is 6726939 MWh, with maximum monthly error2.33e-10MWh. The reconciled hourly hydro total and regional imports are preserved.

evidenceFlow.title: Fresh annual computation
evidenceFlow.detail: Twelve completed months; 8651 successes, zero solver exceptions or lost baseline successes. Independent raw complex-power, current, loss-accounting and source-input readers pass.

evidenceFlow.title: Reviewed interactive map
evidenceFlow.detail: Seven interface series and eleven zones re-exported from fresh annual results; northern St. Lawrence/HQ/PV20 inputs added. Numerical, interaction and actual-browser reviews passed.
